name: Toyota 1KD-FTV
notes: Modern common-rail D-4D diesel (Prado/Hilux/Fortuner-family, 2000-2015). Output varies significantly by market/year/emissions tune (roughly 134-188hp, 300-420Nm across variants) - 170hp/410Nm used here as a representative mid-range figure. Popular swap into older Land Cruisers for its reliability and torque, but its bellhousing pattern doesn't match the older 1HZ/1HD-T family - dedicated adapter/conversion kits exist for exactly this reason. Not factory-fitted to any of our seeded frames.
